title: Caller says your bank account is under attack
what_it_asks_for: Move your money to a 'safe account' or read out a code
warning_signs: Caller says they are from your bank's fraud team
Pressure to act right now
Asks you to move money or share a code
safe_action: Hang up, wait five minutes, and call the number on the back of your card.

title: Text asks for a small parcel redelivery fee
what_it_asks_for: Card details to pay a small fee
warning_signs: Unexpected parcel text
Tiny fee with a short deadline
Odd-looking web link
safe_action: Don't tap the link. Check the delivery in the courier's own app or website.

title: Message says you are owed a tax refund
warning_signs: Refund you didn't expect
Link to claim it
Asks for bank login or card details
safe_action: Tax offices don't text refund links. Log in to the official government site yourself.

title: 'Hi Mum, I've lost my phone' message
what_it_asks_for: Money sent urgently to a new account
warning_signs: Message from a new number
Can't talk on the phone
Needs money today, to an account you don't know
safe_action: Call your family member on their old number, or ask a question only they would know.

title: Pop-up or call says your computer has a virus
what_it_asks_for: Remote access to your computer and a payment
warning_signs: Warning you didn't ask for
Asks you to install an app so they can 'fix' it
Asks for payment or bank login
safe_action: Close the page or hang up. Never let a stranger control your computer.

title: Guaranteed returns on a crypto investment
what_it_asks_for: Money paid into a trading platform
warning_signs: Promises of big, guaranteed returns
Celebrity or friend 'recommends' it
Hard to withdraw your money
safe_action: Check the firm on the official financial regulator's register before paying anything.

title: Online partner you've never met asks for money
what_it_asks_for: Money for travel, medical bills or an emergency
warning_signs: Never able to video call
Strong feelings very fast
Asks for money and to keep it private
safe_action: Never send money to someone you haven't met in person. Talk to a friend you trust.

title: Easy paid tasks that need a deposit
warning_signs: Job offer you didn't apply for
Paid to like or rate things
Must pay in to get paid out
safe_action: Real jobs never ask you to pay to work. Stop and block the contact.

title: Seller asks you to pay outside the marketplace
what_it_asks_for: Bank transfer instead of the site's checkout
warning_signs: Price well below others
Seller wants bank transfer or a 'friends' payment
Moves the chat off the site
safe_action: Pay only through the marketplace's own checkout, which protects you.

title: Someone asks you to read out a code you were sent
what_it_asks_for: The one-time code from a text
warning_signs: You get a code you didn't ask for
Someone calls or messages asking for it
Says it was 'sent by mistake'
safe_action: Never share a one-time code with anyone. It is the key to your account.
